telegramNotifications.helpTitle: How do I get the bot token and chat ID?
telegramNotifications.helpStep1: In Telegram open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow the steps. Copy the token you get.
telegramNotifications.helpStep2: Open your new bot and send it any message (e.g. hi).
telegramNotifications.helpStep3: Open this address in your browser (replace TOKEN with your token):
telegramNotifications.helpStep4: In the result find "chat" and then "id". That number is your chat ID. Paste the token and the chat ID below.
telegramNotifications.noneWarning: Select at least one option to receive Telegram reminders.
telegramNotifications.needCredentials: Save the bot token and chat ID above to enable sending.
telegramNotifications.tokenUnreadable: The saved bot token can no longer be read (the server secret changed). Enter the token again and save.
